title: DDS calculations prototype question pack
description: The questions a user can be asked, and the task list that groups them.

questions.description: Question ids must be unique. Every question must be asked by some task in taskList.

messageKey.description: A key in conf/messages and conf/messages.cy, e.g. Total_income or calculations.taskList.item.aboutYou

id.description: A question id. Answers are stored under it (per-year answers as <id>__<taxYear>).

taskId.description: A task or section id; it appears in URLs

showIf.description: Only ask the question when another question's answer matches. Needs one of equals, contains or notEquals.

field.description: The id of the question whose answer is checked

contains.description: For checkboxes: the option is ticked

options.description: Required for singleChoice and checkboxes, unless optionsFromRates is true

feeds.description: Free-text note on where the answer is used

perTaxYear.description: Ask once for each selected tax year

optionsFromRates.description: Use the rate catalogue's tax years as the options

questions.description: Question ids, in the order they are asked. Questions hidden by showIf are skipped. A question can be in only one task.

leftoverTask.description: Asks the tax year's per-year questions that no other task asks

value.description: An option value of the forEachSelected question

yearTitle.description: When set, the option also gets a task in each tax-year section, asking that year's questions

forEachSelected.description: One task per ticked option of a checkboxes question. A question belongs to an option's task when its showIf is {field: question, contains: value}, or it follows up a question that does.

tasks.description: The options that get a task, in display order. Values must be unique.

id.description: Unique. 'final' and ids starting 'year-' are reserved.

intro.description: Shown above the section on the journey map

startsAfter.description: Earlier sections that must be complete before this section's tasks can start

inOrder.description: Each task starts only once the one before it is complete

eachYear.description: A section repeated for every selected tax year. Tasks are listed as: before, each category's yearTitle task, leftover, after. Only perTaxYear questions can be used.

title.description: {0} is replaced with the tax year, e.g. 2017 to 2018

taskList.description: Which questions are asked in which task. The service adds a final 'Calculate' section after these.
